categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in chemical manufacturing and processing, focusing on five main product categories: oxidation catalysts for PTA production, power battery materials (notably nickel and cobalt sulfates for lithium-ion batteries), fertilizers (both compound and organic), specialty chemicals including electronic-grade sulfuric acid and oxalic acid, and other chemical products such as waste sulfuric acid recycling. It also engages in international trade and environmental waste treatment services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced chemical synthesis and processing technologies including crystallization, reaction, filtration, drying, and packaging for various chemical products. It has developed proprietary catalyst recovery and recycling technologies, and employs ISO-certified management systems (ISO 9001, 14001, 45001, 50001, 14064-1, IATF16949) to ensure quality, environmental, and occupational safety standards. The production of battery materials involves precise control of metal compound ratios and particle structures, while fertilizer production includes mixing, granulation, drying, and coating processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include PTA producers in the chemical fiber industry, lithium-ion battery manufacturers for electric vehicles, agricultural sectors for fertilizers, semiconductor manufacturers for electronic-grade sulfuric acid, and tire manufacturers for cobalt-based chemical materials. The company serves major international battery and automotive companies, semiconductor firms, and agricultural product distributors, with a strong presence in Asia, especially Japan, and expanding markets in China, Southeast Asia, Europe, and the Americas.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and sales cover Taiwan, China (Ningbo, Zhangzhou), Thailand (Rayong), Vietnam (new production base under construction), and international markets including Asia, Europe, and the Americas. The company has established overseas production facilities to be closer to key customers and to diversify geographic risk, with a focus on Asian markets and growing presence in global supply chains.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the chemical and battery materials supply chain, producing key intermediate materials such as oxidation catalysts for PTA, nickel and cobalt sulfates for battery cathodes, and specialty chemicals. It sources upstream raw materials like cobalt and nickel metals globally and supplies downstream manufacturers in the chemical fiber, battery, fertilizer, semiconductor, and tire industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding production capacity for electric vehicle battery materials, developing next-generation cathode materials with improved cost and performance, enhancing catalyst recovery and recycling technologies, and advancing sustainable and environmentally friendly production processes. R&D efforts focus on process optimization, quality improvement, raw material recycling, and development of high-purity metal products aligned with ESG and circular economy principles.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of chemical materials including oxidation catalysts, battery materials, fertilizers, specialty chemicals, and related products. The company also provides catalyst recycling services and engages in international trade. Revenue streams are largely transactional based on volume and price of chemical products supplied to industrial customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in Taiwan’s oxidation catalyst and battery material markets, competing domestically with firms like Meike Chemical. Globally, it competes with major cobalt and nickel chemical producers such as Umicore (Belgium), Jervois (Finland), Shepherd (USA), and Huayou (China). It is recognized as a key supplier to international battery manufacturers and semiconductor firms, maintaining a strong market share and technological edge in its core segments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$4.1 billion in the latest fiscal year, with a net profit turnaround from a loss in the prior year to a net income of NT$225 million. It has a stable asset base near NT$9.85 billion and equity of NT$6.55 billion. Recent years show investment in overseas expansion and R&D, with a focus on sustainable growth driven by the electric vehicle battery materials market. The company maintains solid cash flow and has reduced debt levels.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, stable, and customized chemical products tailored to customer process requirements, supported by strong technical service and after-sales support. It differentiates through proprietary catalyst recovery and recycling technologies, advanced production capabilities for battery materials, and compliance with stringent environmental and quality standards. Its strategic overseas production footprint and close collaboration with international customers enhance responsiveness and competitiveness.
